description: This PHP source file defines a ClientRepository class within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for managing OAuth client entities and their validation within the OAuth2 authentication context. It implements methods to retrieve client entities, validate client credentials, and ensure secure OAuth operations.

classes.name: ClientRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing OAuth client entities, providing methods to retrieve and validate clients against stored credentials and secrets.

methods.name: getOAuthClientById
methods.description: Retrieves an OAuthClient entity by its client identifier if it is enabled.

methods.name: getClientEntity
methods.description: Fetches the client entity object corresponding to a given client identifier for OAuth2 processes.

methods.name: validateClient
methods.description: Validates a client based on its identifier, secret, and grant type, ensuring proper credentials and confidentiality requirements.

methods.name: validateClientSecret
methods.description: Verifies the provided client secret against the stored credential using hashing verification.
